mapping.summary: Lets users set up no-code alerts on any table and field, as tasks or emails.
claims: Alerts can be defined on almost any table and field without coding
Record filters limit alerts to the items you care about
Event stages let you follow how something progresses over time
Alerts are created as user tasks and can also go out by email
Alert emails can use a Word layout for dynamic content
Raises business events that Power Automate or Dataverse can act on, e.g. Teams notifications
Alerts run manually or on a schedule through the job queue
Example: warn when sales quotes are about to expire
Example: warn when receivables are approaching their due date
Example: notify when new items, customers or vendors are created
Example: notify when a posted receipt lands in a given warehouse
